item.title: Coordination server issues
item.description:
Status: Resolved

This incident has been resolved. The authentication failures were due to a service becoming unreachable, and we have worked to restore the service. Approximately 1 in 10 requests between 08:40 and 10:00 UTC were affected, and the issue in this period was intermittent.

Affected components
  • Admin console (console.tailscale.com) (Operational)
